printers.detail: BanknoteNews records Goznak as the new printer of the Banco Central de Cuba's 200-peso note dated 2024 and of the 50-peso note dated 2025; the change is identified from the notes themselves rather than announced by the bank.
printers.source_title: Cuba new printer 200-peso note (B916i) confirmed - BanknoteNews
printers.quote: Like B916h, but new windowed security thread with demetalized BCC, new printer (Goznak), and serif s/n font.

printers.detail: The International Association of Currency Affairs' per-note profile for the Central Bank of Azerbaijan's renewed 50-manat banknote lists G+D Currency Development GmbH as the printer.
printers.source_title: Owner: Central Bank of Azerbaijan - 50 Manat - International Association of Currency Affairs

printers.detail: The same IACA profile for the renewed 50-manat note lists Papierfabrik Louisenthal GmbH as the substrate supplier, a paper maker rather than the printer.
printers.source_title: Owner: Central Bank of Azerbaijan - 50 Manat - International Association of Currency Affairs

printers.detail: Central Banking reports the Banque Centrale de Madagascar's 20,000-ariary note is produced on Giesecke+Devrient's Louisenthal Hybrid substrate; this is the substrate maker, not the printer, which the article does not name.
printers.source_title: Madagascar launches high-denomination banknote - Central Banking
printers.quote: which is being printed on Giesecke and Devrient's (G&D) Louisenthal hybrid

printers.detail: Haitian outlet iciHaiti reports the Banque de la Republique d'Haiti ordered a reprint of 30 million 10-gourde notes from Oberthur Fiduciaire S.A.S. for 845,000 euros; reported by a news outlet rather than announced by the bank.
printers.source_title: iciHaiti - Economy: Reprint of 30 million of 10 Gourde banknotes
printers.quote: has just placed an order for reprinting 30 million of 10 Gourdes notes to the French firm Oberthur Fiduciaire S.A.S.

not_found.note: Opened lexpress.mg 2024-05 'L'ariary continue a etre imprime ailleurs': says Madagascar's notes 'dependent totalement des imprimeries europeennes et americaines' and that the central bank has no plan to print its own, but names no firm. Continuing with procurement/IACA leads.

Opened the National Bank of Georgia's own page 'Upgraded Georgian Lari Banknotes' (nbg.gov.ge/en/media/news/upgraded-georgian-lari-banknotes). It names Giesecke & Devrient (Germany) and Oberthur Fiduciaire (France) among 'the world's leading security printing companies' that 'participated in the process of improvement of the upgraded design' - a design statement, not a printing statement. No printer and no paper supplier named. Not filed, consistent with last round's refusal.
Also opened currencyaffairs.org/?p=2706 (CBAR upgraded 10- and 20-manat notes, 2022): names no printer and no substrate maker. The 50-manat profile (?p=1846) did, and is filed.

Dollarization confirmed from the law itself: Decree-Law No. 20/2003 'On the Legal Tender in Timor-Leste', 13 November 2003 (lpr.adb.org/sites/default/files/resource/[nid]/timor-leste-legal-tender-of-timor-leste-english.pdf), s.2.1: 'The official currency of the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste is the US dollar.' The circulating notes are US Federal Reserve notes printed by the US Bureau of Engraving and Printing, which is not the Banco Central de Timor-Leste's printer; no printer filed. The BCTL issues only centavo coins.

Confirmed Palestine has no currency of its own. Global Finance interview with Feras Milhem, Governor of the Palestine Monetary Authority (gfmag.com, 'Bank Without Currency'): 'Central banking in Palestine is unique, given that the PMA does not issue nor manage a national currency.' He adds: 'Three foreign currencies are in circulation: the Israeli shekel, the US dollar, and the Jordanian dinar.' No printer exists to file.

Opened icihaiti.com news-37231 'All about the new 1,000 gourdes note': describes the portrait, the Valliere Market reverse and the security features but names no printer and no paper supplier. BanknoteNews has no Printer field on Haiti (established last round). Nothing filed.

Dollarization confirmed. Primicias (18 March 2025) on Executive Decree 565: 'Ratificar como unidad monetaria y unico medio de pago oficial en la Republica del Ecuador al dolar.' Ecuador's circulating notes are therefore US Federal Reserve notes from the US Bureau of Engraving and Printing, not a printer engaged by the Banco Central del Ecuador; no printer filed. Source: primicias.ec/politica/presidente-daniel-noboa-anuncia-decreto-ejecutivo-dolarizacion-dolar-ecuador-91992

Dollarization confirmed from the statute. Ley de Integracion Monetaria (text on el-salvador.justia.com/nacionales/leyes/ley-de-integracion-monetaria/gdoc), Art. 3: 'El dolar tendra curso legal irrestricto con poder liberatorio ilimitado'; Art. 5 leaves pre-existing colon notes legal tender but requires banks to exchange them for dollars. The law provides for no issuance of Salvadoran banknotes, so the circulating notes are US Federal Reserve notes printed by the US Bureau of Engraving and Printing, which is not the BCR's printer; no printer filed.

Searched for a Banque Centrale de Djibouti printing tender and for a new-series announcement naming a printer; the procurement hits returned were BCEAO (West Africa) documents and unrelated Djibouti public-works tenders, and the Djibouti results were collector catalogue pages only. Nothing filed. Also opened BanknoteNews banknotenews.com/?p=3359 (40-franc independence commemorative): names only the issuer, 'The Banque Centrale de Djibouti introduced this 40-franc note...', with no Printer field.

Worked the mtender.gov.md / achizitii.md vein as directed. The BNM's own procurement-contract monitoring reports for 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026-H1 (bnm.md/ro/print/content/raport-privind-monitorizarea-executarii-contractelor-de-achizitii-publice-ale-bancii, downloaded the XLS files) contain no banknote printing contract: the currency-related entries are Regia Autonoma Monetaria Statului (Romania) and Monetaria Lituaniei for commemorative coins, and Giesecke+Devrient Currency Technology GmbH for modernising BPS M-7 banknote processing and packing equipment (350,400 EUR, 2024) - machinery, not printing. Several related tender files on mtender are marked 'Secret Profesional'. Nothing filed. Also opened the BNM's own new 10-lei banknote page (bnm.md/en/printpdf/content/new-mdl-10-banknote): says only 'Printed on special paper', naming no manufacturer.

Central Banking's article names only the Louisenthal Hybrid substrate (filed as a paper record); the printer of the ariary series remains unnamed. lexpress.mg says only that production is in Europe and the United States.

Guinea stays closed negatively, as last round established from the BCRG's own recognition poster.
